fact: On 17 June 2026 the Minister of Communication and New Information Technologies listed among the coming months' priorities the adoption of the decree approving the PNDN 2026-2035 and the PSDN 2026-2030, so neither was yet approved.
title: Entretien exclusif sur la RTN : Le ministre M. Adji Ali Salatou édifie l'opinion nationale sur les actions de son département ministériel
